title: Omg, Amazon Prime  inserted an ad for Febreze  in the...
content: Omg, Amazon Prime inserted an ad for Febreze in the midst of the most famous match cut in the history of cinema (in Kubrick’s 2001, when the ape-thrown bone turns into a spacecraft). I don’t know whether to laugh or cry (rn, it’s both).
author: Jason Kottke
